name: account.forget
description: Forgets a brand's account on one platform, and its tokens: only the account named, so one linked since is kept. Instagram and Facebook only by an owner or admin of the brand's company. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: with a as (delete from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = :brand and a.platform = :platform and a.account_id = :accountId returning a.*), k as (insert into brandbase.connections as c (brand_id, key, status) select a.brand_id, x.key, 'off' from a, brandbase.account_connections(a.platform, a.details) x on conflict (brand_id, key) do update set status = excluded.status, updated_at = now()) select jsonb_build_object('platform', a.platform, 'accountId', a.account_id) as result from a
